name: Stanovjas' legendoj: Novoe prishestvie
source:
Welcome to the world of medieval intrigue! You are a novice thief, full of ambition and eager for fame. And your first serious contract promises to change your life. However, things quickly spiral out of control: your life takes a drastic turn when you become the target of a cultist conspiracy and gain the power you must learn to control.

Master your newfound abilities, build relationships, and shape both your own fate and the fate of the whole world. Your legend begins here!

[From [url=https://midnight-artwork.itch.io/becoming-a-legend]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到中世纪阴谋的世界！你是一个新手小偷，野心勃勃，渴望名誉。你的第一份严肃合同有望改变你的生活。然而，事情很快就失控了：当你成为邪教阴谋的目标并获得必须学会控制的力量时，你的生活发生了巨大的转变。

掌握你新发现的能力，建立关系，塑造你自己的命运和整个世界的命运。你的传奇从这里开始！

[来自[url=https://midnight-artwork.itch.io/becoming-a-legend]Itch.io[/url]]
